name: Avoiding images
description: Refusing to depict the divine.

name: Sacred calligraphy
description: Writing holy words as an act of devotion.

name: Sacred images
description: Statues, icons and paintings used in worship.

name: Masked ritual
description: Masks worn to embody gods, spirits or ancestors.

name: Ritual rock and cave art
description: Painting or engraving rock surfaces for ritual purposes.

name: Sand and ground painting
description: Images made on the ground for healing or ritual.

name: Mission
description: Spreading the faith to others.

name: Asceticism and renunciation
description: Giving up comfort, property or family for spiritual ends.

name: Confession and repentance
description: Admitting wrongdoing to the divine or a minister.

name: Dietary laws
description: Rules on what may be eaten and how.

name: Fasting
description: Going without food or drink for a set time.

name: Monastic life
description: Living in a community under vows.

name: Sacred plants
description: Peyote, ayahuasca, iboga, mushrooms or other plants taken to meet the sacred.

name: Speaking in tongues
description: Ecstatic speech believed to be given by the Spirit.

name: Shamanic journeying
description: A specialist's soul travels to spirit worlds to heal or guide.

name: Trance and spirit possession
description: A god or spirit 'mounts' or speaks through a person.

name: Vision quest
description: Seeking a vision through solitude and fasting.

name: Charity and almsgiving
description: Giving to the poor and to religious communities.

name: Non-violence
description: Refusing to harm living beings.

name: Exorcism
description: Driving out harmful spirits.

name: Ritual and faith healing
description: Curing illness by prayer, ritual or spiritual power.

name: Ancestor veneration
description: Honouring, feeding and consulting the family or royal dead.

name: Funerary rites
description: Burial, cremation or other ritual care of the dead.

name: Preserving the dead
description: Mummification and other preservation of bodies.

name: Rites of passage
description: Ceremonies at birth, coming of age and marriage.

name: Alchemy
description: Transforming matter and the self.

name: Amulets and protective magic
description: Charms, talismans and spells for protection or luck.

name: Ceremonial magic
description: Learned ritual to command spiritual powers.

name: Meditation
description: Disciplined attention, stillness or contemplation.

name: Mystical union
description: Seeking direct experience of or union with the divine.

name: Tantra
description: Esoteric ritual and meditation using body, mantra and diagram.

name: Yoga and breath discipline
description: Bodily and breath practices to unite with or realise the divine.

name: Priesthood
description: Specialists who perform rites for the community.

name: Sacred kingship
description: Rulers seen as divine, descended from gods or ritually central.

name: Circumambulation
description: Walking around a sacred object or place.

name: Monument building
description: Raising megaliths, mounds, pyramids or sanctuaries.

name: Pilgrimage
description: Journeying to a holy place.

name: Processions
description: Carrying gods, relics or images through the streets.

name: Sacred natural places
description: Mountains, rivers, springs, rocks and groves treated as holy.

name: Temple worship
description: Worship centred on a built house of a god.

name: Astrology
description: Reading the heavens for fate and timing.

name: Divination
description: Reading signs to learn the will of gods or the future.

name: Dream revelation
description: Messages held to come from the divine, received in dreams.

name: Mediumship and channelling
description: Contact with the dead or spirit teachers through a medium.

name: Oracles
description: Seeking a god's answer through a priest, medium or sacred place.

name: Prophecy
description: Speaking messages held to be received from the divine.

name: Spirit writing
description: Texts written under the control of a god or spirit.

name: Animal sacrifice
description: Ritual killing of animals for a god or spirits.

name: Baptism
description: Initiation or cleansing by water.

name: Fire ritual
description: Sacred fire as offering place, messenger or object of reverence.

name: Human sacrifice
description: Ritual killing of people (historical).

name: Initiation
description: Admission to a community, secret society or grade of knowledge.

name: Libation
description: Pouring a drink out as an offering.

name: Offerings
description: Gifts of food, drink, flowers, incense or goods to gods, spirits or ancestors.

name: Ritual purification
description: Washing, bathing or other acts that remove impurity.

name: Sacraments
description: Rites believed to convey divine grace.

name: Sacred meal or communion
description: Eating and drinking together as a holy act.

name: Sweat lodge
description: Purification and prayer in a heated lodge.

name: Sacred oral tradition
description: Myths, laws and songs passed down by word of mouth.

name: Sacred language
description: Worship in a special or ancient language.

name: Study of scripture
description: Reading, memorising and interpreting sacred texts.

name: Theology and philosophy
description: Reasoned debate about the divine.

name: Festival calendar
description: An annual cycle of holy days and festivals.

name: Weekly holy day
description: A day set apart for rest or worship each week.

name: Sacred astronomy
description: Watching the sun, moon and stars to time rites or read the will of heaven.

name: Animism
description: Belief that animals, plants, places and objects have spirits.

name: Totemism
description: Kin groups bound to an animal or plant ancestor, with rules and rites.

name: Chant and mantra
description: Repeating sacred sounds, names or formulas.

name: Drumming and sacred dance
description: Rhythm and movement as worship or to call the divine.

name: Hymns and sacred song
description: Singing in praise, thanks or petition.

name: Formal liturgy
description: Communal services with fixed words, order and roles.

name: Prayer
description: Addressing a god, spirits or the divine in words, spoken or silent.
